nom: celimax The Real Noni Bubble Foam Face Cleanser

avis.titre: Gentle, Refreshing, and Perfect for All Skin Types!
avis.texte: The Celimax Noni Bubble Cleanser is one of the best face washes I’ve used! It creates a soft, rich foam that feels super gentle on the skin but still leaves my face feeling clean and fresh. It doesn’t strip my skin or cause any tightness — just a nice, balanced cleanse. I have combination skin and it works great, calming any redness while helping with oil control. Love the noni extract and how soothing it is. Perfect for daily use — highly recommend!
I love this foam cleanser! The Noni line from celimax is amazing and it has really helped with clearing up my face!
Este jabón es de otro mundo. Me a funcionado en los primeros días de uso, observo mi piel más limpia, no acumulo grasa y lo mejor no me salen granitos. Yo lo compraría nuevamente 100% recomendado

This celimax noni cleanser is working great so far. I would say it really cleans my skin, but I don’t use it too often because I have dry combination skin. I only use it at night and alternate it with a more moisturizing cleanser to avoid stripping my skin barrier.
It’s a good base cleanser but it did not help with my acne at all.
Le produit mousse à la pression du flacon. Il permet un second nettoyage en douceur de la peau après utilisation d'un produit démaquillant. Je le recommande
Me encanta como limpia y como me deja la piel, seguiré comprándolo sin duda
The best face wash I ever use, compared with other top level brands.
Llevo varios meses usándolo y siento que me ha ayudado con mi piel mixta; no me han salido brotes y me ha funcionado para mi piel. Ya que es sensible, lo recomiendo mucho.

I’ve been using this cleansing foam for about two weeks, and I really like it. This is my first product from this brand, and I’m impressed so far. My skin reacts great to it — no breakouts or irritation. I’m definitely considering trying more products from this brand in the future.
Me encantó este limpiador, hace muy bien su trabajo además te deja tu rostro hidratado, volveré a comprar ya se me está terminando
Este producto lo recomiendo excelente a mi hija le funciona muy bien

I have combination skin, where I have an oily forehead, nose and chin. I have acne and sensitive skin. I really wanted to try something new since my green cerave foam cleansing was running low. I found this and thought I give it a try. This is made in Korea and stated it was for acne skin. To be honest I was worried it might be strong on my face. After trying it for a few days, morning, noon and night, there wasn't any dryness or irritation. It cleaned my face well and didn't cause any new acne. The cleanser didn’t strip my face and get thet weird tight feeling after washing. My face felt nice and smooth. It removed some of my makeup but still needed makeup remover for lipstick and eyes. There is a pleasant smell to the foam, smells like tea tree or rosemary oil. This isn't a cure all for acne but it's an addition to my acne regime. Make sure you read the instructions, I didn't and pumped way too much foam and over did it the first time. It says all you need is one pump and it lathers up well. I think I have a new favorite cleanser and the price point is comparable to the cerave green cleanser for combo skin.

This cleanser is wonderful! I am middle aged (50+) and break out like crazy. More than I did in my teenage years. I always have something going on. I started using this cleanser about a month ago and haven't had anything since. It leaves my face feeling clean and soft. The scent is nice and not overpowering. I have very sensitive skin which is probably why I have problems with most cleansers, but I have not had any issue with this. I use an anti-wrinkle moisturizer afterwards just for an added benefit. I don't think it's completely necessary because this seems to work well. The application bottle is large and will last for quite a while. I only use one pump twice a day and it covers my entire face. The foam cleanser is refreshing and makes me feel great. I have had no breakouts, no rashes and no splotchy spots. It's just clean and soft skin.

avis.titre: Cleans well and has a pleasant scent.
avis.texte: This stuff cleans my face really well at the end of the day, cutting through whatever dirt or grime was in the air. It must be an astringent given the way it slices through the dirt. I have the sense that it cleans rather deeply, as well. I've been using those little white make-up pads (sort of a felt mat material). They work well with this foam, which is surprisingly thick. The bottle has an interesting foaming nozzle. I like the scent, which is more subtle than other similar items. All in all, a great product that does what it promises.
